title: Add constrained semantic evidence matcher

gates.unit: PASS - 418 passed / 2 pre-existing failures (baseline 404 + 14 new matcher tests)
gates.integration: PASS - 114 passed (unchanged, no DB surface touched)
gates.ruff: PASS - 2 pre-existing errors (test_quality_scripts.py F841, test_reparse.py I001); 0 new

acceptance.strict_pydantic_contracts_and_applicatio: PASS - dataclass-based strict contracts (MatchedDimension/MatchedGap/MatchSemanticResult) returned by the adapter; _validate_output is a strict structural validator (dimension key allow-list, raw_score/confidence bounds, evidence ID allow-list, gap category/severity bounds, duplicate detection); matcher takes the domain SourceCatalog (application-owned interface) and returns engine inputs ready for evaluate()
acceptance.bounded_masked_catalog_through_gateway_a: PASS - _build_payload bounds items to requested dimensions (MAX_DIMENSION_ITEMS=80, MAX_ITEM_EXCERPT_CHARS=300), excerpts are the catalog's masked values only; gateway.complete called with privacy_required=True so the gateway's PrivacyGuard fails closed on any unmasked resume-derived payload; gateway-spy test proves the sent messages contain only allow-listed catalog IDs and no candidate identifiers
acceptance.reject_unknown_ids_conflicting_categorie: PASS - unknown cited evidence IDs rejected (retry then MatchSemanticError after exhaustion); conflicting categories for one requirement rejected as duplicate -> one primary gap; invalid/duplicated dimension keys rejected; raw_score outside [0,100] rejected; malformed JSON rejected; catalog claims containing injection instructions are sent only as data (system prompt demands ignoring them) - test proves the injected item stays bounded and masked
acceptance.gateway_timeout_and_bounded_retry_withou: PASS - gateway exceptions (incl. timeout) surface as typed MatchSemanticError with no provider payload leaked; MAX_RETRIES=1 bounded retry appends previous response + validation context (test asserts retry messages contain assistant response and Validation error); caller pattern documented: config copied, then session.rollback() before awaiting the provider (no transaction held)
acceptance.persist_no_prompt_completion_raw_respons: PASS - the matcher never logs or returns prompts/completions; _safe() reduces errors to typed code or exception class name; MatchSemanticError messages carry only safe public diagnostics; API keys live in the gateway only; masked-excerpt-only payload means no unmasked resume content ever reaches the provider
acceptance.deterministic_fake_and_gateway_spy_tests: PASS - 14 tests: success, gateway-spy masking assertion, unknown-ID reject (retry-success and retry-exhausted), duplicate dimension, invalid dimension key, out-of-bounds score, conflicting gap categories, malformed JSON, timeout leak-free, prompt injection, dimension bounding, invalid dimension request, retry validation context

implementation_notes: New backend/infrastructure/matchers/ package (per RIP-013 section 8 layout): __init__.py holds the adapter (LLMGateway + PrivacyGuard through gateway.complete(privacy_required=True), bounded payload, strict validation, bounded retry); no SQLAlchemy imports - persistence wiring lands with the assessment lifecycle (#109/#110)

The matcher consumes the domain SourceCatalog (issue #107) and returns dataclass inputs that map 1:1 onto the engine's MatchV1Input (DimensionInput/GapInput) - the wiring from MatchSemanticResult to evaluate() lands in the assessment worker (#110)
MatchedGap carries uncertain flag; the engine's default classifier (issue #107) resolves uncertain -> evidence_gap per RIP-013 6.4

Prompt boundary follows the plan_generation pattern (system prompt declares catalog as untrusted data; user prompt renders the bounded catalog JSON); dimension key list stated in the Rules section to avoid an over-long schema line
normalize_requirement_skill helper re-exports the policy alias normalization for downstream deterministic rules
residual_risks: Real-provider prompt-following quality is not verifiable without a live LLM config - the deterministic fake proves the contract, not model behavior; the acceptance suite for #111 will exercise the gateway-boundary spy
The engine/application wiring (assessment lifecycle, worker, API) is intentionally out of scope and lands in #109/#110

reviews.note: Constrained semantic matcher implemented as a narrow LLM adapter with strict allow-list validation, masked bounded payloads through the gateway+PrivacyGuard, typed leak-free errors, bounded retry, and no persistence of prompts/completions/keys. 14 unit tests with deterministic fake gateway + gateway spy cover success, insufficient evidence, malicious, timeout, and invalid-output branches; full gates green (unit 418/2 pre-existing, integration 114, ruff/mypy 0 new, arch 0 new, no migration)
